description: Parameters of Hybrid Current Controller Limiter. Regulates the magnitude of the inverter output current, but with a closed loop feedback regulated by a virtual impedance which provides ant-windup. Described in: Novel Hybrid Current Limiter for Grid-Forming Inverter Control During Unbalanced Faults by Baeckland and Seo, 2023

I_max.description: Maximum limit on current controller input current

rv.description: Real part of the virtual impedance

lv.description: Imaginary part of the virtual impedance

title: HybridOutputCurrentLimiter
